prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Austrian woman — the personification of Vienna — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Vienna as her world knows it — a far-future city two centuries from now: sleek curved architecture, smart glowing materials, holographic interfaces, layered levels of the city and quiet flying vehicles; even an everyday place is rebuilt in that future, not today's Vienna with neon added. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, towers, giant holograms or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: a little sausage stand two centuries on, its narrow counter softly glowing on a quiet corner late at night, sausages sizzling under a warm light hood.
Around her, as her world makes them: a hot cheese-filled sausage on a warm tray with a dab of mustard and the heel of a brown loaf; a glass of glowing liquor on a lit base; a holographic phone screen projected from her wrist.
Season: spring — changeable days of sun and passing cloud, the parks greening and the last frosts of April fading.
Time of day: past midnight — the last lamps still burning and the streets nearly empty; warm pools of lamplight, soft shadow beyond.
Light direction: side light — the light falls from one side, the far side of her face in soft shadow.
Small moment: a small glitter sticker sparkles on her cheek.
Outfit: romantic goth — a black velvet dress with a corset belt and lace sleeves, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday techwear — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of technical fabrics with reflective panels, glowing seam lines, magnetic clasps and chunky-soled boots.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a close-up of her face and hair; body facing the camera; head facing the camera straight on, both ears about equally visible; camera slightly above, looking down at her; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand holds a V sign over one eye, that eye peeking out between her two spread fingers — one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: crinkled lower eyelids, closed-lip smile pushing the cheeks up, brows relaxed.

Framing: a close-up — her face and hair fill most of the frame and the bottom edge crosses at her collarbones; nothing below the shoulders shows, and her hands and anything she holds stay below the frame unless raised to her face.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia — and leave behind the object she holds in it; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: her world's signature object — a small round silver tray balancing a cup of milky coffee under a cap of foam beside a glass of cold water — appears only as one small accessory shaped after it (a charm, brooch, pendant or hair ornament) or set down beside her in the scene; she does not hold it unless PROP names it.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. Any animal or creature that belongs to the place stays separate from her at its own natural scale — never touching, held by or merged with her body.

generation.note: Original PNG retained locally; only WebP and source hash published.

acceptance: User selected world #2 and preauthorized image and dex commits and normal main updates. No force update or deletion.

observations: Face and hand match identity; raised V-sign has natural finger arrangement. Frame extends to bust rather than stopping at collarbones.
Reference earrings remain; landmark-like elevated architecture added behind the stand despite the location guard.
qa.cause: Generated interpretation differs in framing, surface finish or details as listed; preserved under authorized QA workflow without regeneration.
